why: Both match the key's hedgehog, stop-doing decisions and brutal facts almost equally; Analysis 1 is better calibrated (it flags the cost-per-student versus budget mismatch and unknown board size, where Analysis 2 cites a contingency budget not in the dossier) and its verdict rules directly on the three board decisions. Analysis 2 wins overall on a close call because it explicitly names Calloway as already great, runs in stewardship mode, and keeps its list to a few real temptations that preserve the proven core, which is the restraint this track rewards.
